title: The Pawn Takes All
setup: Your c6 pawn is two steps from a new queen, with the black king on b8 and a rook on d8.
hint: A pawn attacks two squares diagonally. Find the advance that hits both, then count who defends it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c7+}} attacks b8 and d8 together, and the rook on c1 guards the pawn, so the king cannot eat it. Its own pawns and bishop leave only {{Ka8}}, and {{cxd8=Q}} takes the rook and brings a new queen in one move.
